title: Review: trust.py security+rotation 2026-08-24
notes:
Review confidence: 10% chance of missed bug.
The key rotation implementation is solid:
- compute_rotation_transcript binds to old_pubkey + old_iid + new_pubkey + sequence
- rotate_key computes transcript internally (no caller-supplied message)
- Anti-replay via monotonic sequence
- Persistence required for production rotation
- Rollback on save failure
- Collision detection prevents rotating to already-pinned IID
- TrustEntry is frozen dataclass with MappingProxyType metadata

No findings. The linter/formatter enhanced the code beyond my original fix.
